summary: You can turn Gemini out of Gmail, but only through the "smart features" bundle — an all-or-nothing switch that also kills conveniences that have nothing to do with AI. It lives in two separate places and both must be off.

steps.path: Gmail → gear icon → See all settings → General → uncheck "Turn on smart features in Gmail, Chat and Meet"
Same page → Google Workspace smart features → Manage settings → toggle off both "Smart features in Google Workspace" and "Smart features in other Google products" → Save
Optional: turn off Smart Compose, Smart Compose personalization and Smart Reply individually if you keep smart features on.

collateral: spelling and grammar check goes away with the bundle
auto-added calendar events from email invitations stop working
package tracking and Wallet/Maps conveniences stop working
regionNotes: Smart features are off by default in the EEA, UK, Switzerland and Japan. Everywhere else you were opted in.
whyTheyDidIt: Bundling the AI with genuinely useful non-AI conveniences makes opting out expensive on purpose.
